label: AI developer tooling (l0 family and friends)
text: l0-memory (minimal long-term memory for AI assistants: Go MCP + SQLite), l0-git (deterministic project-hygiene gates), l0-compressor (compresses command output to save tokens), slopless (static analysis for AI-slop patterns), noted (local-first Markdown notes with AI), silicondev (local LLM fine-tuning on Apple Silicon), git-flare (coordinating many coding agents on one repo).
